review_timing: After pilots; structural attribution only, no model/config/loss/gate changes

deeponet.citation: Lu et al., NMI 2021, arXiv:1910.03193 (downloaded arXiv original manuscript title differs from journal title)

deeponet.canonical: single branch vector and trunk vector, inner product plus scalar bias; branch CNN permitted by high-level architecture
deeponet.adaptations: variable station geometry/masks, sorted padded slots, CNN branch, linear final trunk layer, final sigmoid for concentration range; not official experiment reproduction

fno.canonical: sigma(Wv + inverseFFT(R*FFT(v))), truncated complex spectral modes, pointwise channel mixing, four layers
fno.adaptations: fixed ray-adjoint input, 3D grid, width16/modes8, GELU, no batch norm, padding and sigmoid; paper experiments describe ReLU/batch normalization, dimensions/training budget differ under common task protocol
